question: Sujata Mahapatra has won the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sujata Mahapatra** has won the **Sangeet Natak Akademi** award for her contribution to **Odissi music and dance.**
 
• Odissi is one of the **eight classical dance** forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• The dance style is known for its **graceful movements, intricate footwork,** and **expressive facial gestures.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **Kathak**, is another classical dance form of India, which originated in **Northern India**.

 
 
• It is known for its **fast footwork and spins.**
 
 
 
• Option 3, **Fusion Dance**, is a **contemporary dance form** that combines elements from various dance styles.
 
• Option 4, **Adhunik Nritya**, is a **modern dance** form that originated in India in the** 20th century,** influenced by Western dance styles.
 
• Hence, the statement "The** correct** answer is option 1" is correct.
